No. The door admission is separate, and is paid in advance. In addition to the door admission there is a one drink minimum per person. This includes soft drinks, juices, and bottled water. description.value: Village Vanguard is a jazz club at Seventh Avenue South in Greenwich Village and the oldest operating jazz club in New York City. Shows start at 8:00 p.m. and 10:00 p.m. There is a one drink minimum per person, and the club serves no food. Tripadvisor shows Reviews (467). Representative Tripadvisor praise (search snapshot): “This place definitely lives up to the reputation”; “the focus is truly on the music”. Representative watch-outs: “I sat behind a pole”; “be careful at the steep stairs taking you to the basement room”.
